text:
Aisha: quick async check — what I did yesterday: onboarded tiny-llama-v2 (quantized) to the dedicated pool, ran the prod-smoke-v2 eval suite, and started a small spanish promptset pass. Observed a noticeable regression: ROUGE-L down ~3.2% and hallucination rate up on doc-summarize prompts. Blocker: tokenizer mismatch on some Spanish inputs (looks like byte/whitespace handling). Asking @Ravi to prioritize a quick look at the quant PR (see PR #482) because the reorder kernel change might be related. Planning today: run full evalset, try a tokenizer shim, and iterate promptset doc-summarize-v3-spanish.

Ravi: on it — I'll pull PR #482 now. If it's the reorder kernel that's a likely culprit. can you paste a minimal failing example? :eyes:

Aisha: here's a short failing pair — input then output:
```
Input: "Resumen: ¿Cuál es la política?"
Expected: "La política establece..."
Model: "La política establece. < hallucinated extra>"
```
noticed truncation+extra token insert between "establece" and punctuation on a couple examples.

Tessa: fyi i saw similar artifacts in earlier tiny quant runs — might be kv-cache alignment + token index shift after quant reorder. Ravi, worth double-checking the attention indexing.

Ravi: good call. i'll run a quick repro locally with the same tokenizer config. if it's index-shifted logits we'll see token misalignment in the logits trace. sending a ping when i have a short repro.

eval-bot: regression-alert — model tiny-llama-v2 failed threshold on prod-smoke-v2 (ROUGE-L: -3.2%, HallucinationRate: +4.8%). Linked run: run_2026_04_21_0932

Kai: quick idea — before deep dive, try swapping to the non-reordered kernel variant (flag: --kern-legacy) and re-run the failing subset. that's quick and can help confirm kernel as root cause.

Aisha: great — i'll try --kern-legacy on the failing shard now and post results. if that mitigates, we can gate PR #482 until we squash the alignment bug.

Ravi: repro up in ~15m, i'll attach logs. if it's kernel related we can add a temporary compat shim in the runtime to detect token-index mismatch and fallback.

Tessa: also, small ops ask — can we add the failing examples to the promptset's hotlist so we don't regress on them again? i can add doc-summarize-v3-spanish/hotlist.

Aisha: yes please add them. tagging @Tessa to add hotlist entries. thanks all — i'll post the --kern-legacy results in this thread once done. :thumbsup:
